viettel.name: Viettel
mobifone_advantages: Modem WiFi 6 tang mien phi (Viettel thuong tinh phi thue thiet bi)
Uu dai dong trc 6 tang 2 thang (Viettel khong co chinh sach tuong duong mac dinh)
Cam ket nghiem thu: Mang muot moi thu tien - Viettel thu tien truoc

viettel.response_template: Da Viettel la nha mang uy tin, tuy nhien MobiFone hien co 3 diem vuot troi anh/chi nen biet: (1) Tang mien phi Modem WiFi 6 tri gia 1.5 trieu, (2) Uu dai dong truoc tang them thang su dung, (3) Nghiem thu muot tai nha moi thu tien. Anh/chi co muon do song mien phi truoc khi quyet dinh khong?

vnpt.name: VNPT/VinaPhone
mobifone_advantages: Mang di dong MobiFone manh hon tai khu vuc nong thon/ngoai thanh
Modem WiFi 6 cong nghe moi nhat (VNPT van dung WiFi 5)
Quy trinh lap dat nhanh hon (2-4h, VNPT thuong 1-3 ngay lam viec)
Doi ngu ky thuat tre, am hieu cong nghe moi
vnpt.response_template: Da VNPT cung la lua chon tot, nhung voi MobiFone anh/chi duoc trang bi Modem WiFi 6 cong nghe moi nhat (toc do cao hon 3-4 lan WiFi 5, xuyen tuong cuc tot), va quy trinh lap dat nhanh trong ngay. Anh/chi co muon ky thuat vien den do song thuc te tai nha mien phi khong?

mobifone_advantages: MobiFone la mang quoc doanh, phu song toan quoc rong hon
Chinh sach bao hanh Modem suot thoi gian su dung (FPT thue thiet bi)
Uu dai dong truoc tang thang su dung mien phi

fpt.response_template: Da FPT co dich vu tot tai khu vuc thanh pho lon. Voi MobiFone, anh/chi so huu luon Modem WiFi 6 (bao hanh suot thoi gian dung) thay vi thue thiet bi nhu FPT, va duoc huong uu dai tang them thang cuoc mien phi. Anh/chi cho Mia so dien thoai de khao sat kha nang phu song tai dia chi nhe!
